shots.title: Upload a solicitation
shots.note: Where a solicitation enters. Documents shred here; their text is what now reaches ranking.

shots.title: Intake queue
shots.note: stageIntake is the one entry point — admin uploads and released scout findings both funnel through it.

shots.title: Scout findings
shots.note: Crawler leads and HITL scout extractions, classified NEW vs UPDATE, released or dismissed.

shots.title: Curation queue
shots.note: Every solicitation awaiting curation, with its ingest phase.

shots.title: Ingest Studio
shots.note: The solicitation workspace: compliance matrix, volumes, spotlight summary. The release gate reads the summary.

shots.title: Topic — technology focus areas
shots.note: Where techFocusAreas is edited. It crosses the bridge as of mig 238; before that it stopped here.

shots.title: Opportunities — approve and push
shots.note: The gate: submission_format present and a non-empty spotlight summary. Approval fans every activated opportunity onto the bridge.

shots.title: Mirror cards, all tenants
shots.note: What each tenant received. The card now carries tech focus, phase, topic identity, POC and a document manifest.

shots.title: Workflow map
shots.note: The automation behind the fan-out — templates as DAGs plus live per-instance overlays.

shots.title: Provisioning queue
shots.note: Purchases awaiting release, against the 72-hour SLA.

shots.title: Provisioning cockpit
shots.note: Buyer, SLA countdown, build-out readiness, and the two-outcome Complete & Release.

shots.title: Buckets — a new customer sees this
shots.note: No lenses yet. It says what a bucket IS and states the fallback, because "no buckets" must not read as "your opportunities are missing".

shots.title: Prefilled from the company profile
shots.note: One click copies naics_codes, keywords and agency priorities off tenant_profiles. It FILLS — a field already typed into is left alone.

shots.title: The composition line
shots.note: What the lens will actually score on, computed off the SCORER's own weight table so the number cannot drift from the score it describes.

shots.title: Buckets — five live lenses
shots.note: Each bucket scores the WHOLE mirror. A bucket is a sort order over every card, not a filter on some of them.

shots.title: A bucket ranked
shots.note: "Additive Construction & 3D Printing" ranked against the tenant's whole opportunity mirror, with the per-signal factors behind each score.

shots.title: Opportunity cards
shots.note: The mirror itself — searchable and sortable across every card the tenant holds.

shots.title: Command Center
shots.note: What is new since the customer last looked.

shots.title: Proposals
shots.note: Every build this tenant owns.

shots.title: Proposal workspace
shots.note: Volumes, sections, compliance and readiness. source_bucket is frozen here at provisioning — which lens surfaced the opportunity that became this build.
